tasks.title: The value from the knob (Copter TUNE)
tasks.statement: `RC6_OPTION = 219`, `RC6_MIN = {mn}`, `RC6_MAX = {mx}`, `RC6_REVERSED = 0`, `TUNE = 4`, `TUNE_MIN = {a}`, `TUNE_MAX = {b}`. The knob is at **{p} µs**. What value does `ATC_RAT_RLL_P` get?
tasks.solution: The fraction of travel is d = (PWM − RC6_MIN) / (RC6_MAX − RC6_MIN), constrained to 0…1; value = TUNE_MIN + (TUNE_MAX − TUNE_MIN) · d. `RC6_TRIM` is not involved. The module's example: 1100…1900, 0.05…0.25, 1750 µs → d = 0.8125 → 0.2125; 1000 µs → d is constrained to 0 → 0.05.

tasks.title: Where the original value is on the knob
tasks.statement: `RC6_MIN = {mn}`, `RC6_MAX = {mx}`, `TUNE_MIN = {a}`, `TUNE_MAX = {b}`. The saved value of the gain is **{v}**. At how many microseconds must the knob be for the gain not to change after power-up?
tasks.solution: The inverse formula: PWM = RC6_MIN + (v − TUNE_MIN) / (TUNE_MAX − TUNE_MIN) · (RC6_MAX − RC6_MIN). The module's example: 1100…1900, 0.05…0.25, v = 0.135 → 1100 + 0.425 · 800 = 1440 µs. The middle of the travel gives the middle of the range, not the saved value.

tasks.title: When a switch triggers
tasks.statement: Aux channels are read at the 0, 100, 200 ms marks and so on (an ideal 10 Hz tick). A switch changed position at **{t} ms** and did not move again. At which mark (ms) does ArduPilot call the function?
tasks.solution: The new position is seen at the first mark not earlier than the flick: ⌈t / 100⌉ · 100. The function is called at the first mark where at least `SWITCH_DEBOUNCE_TIME_MS` = 200 ms have passed: another + 200. The module's example: 1030 → seen at 1100 → called at 1300 ms.

tasks.title: Position of a six-position switch
tasks.statement: The mode channel (`FLTMODE_CH`) or the VTX power channel (`RCx_OPTION = 94`) is at **{p} µs**. Which position (from 1 to 6) does ArduPilot determine?
tasks.solution: The boundaries from `read_6pos_switch`: below 1231 is position 1, below 1361 is 2, below 1491 is 3, below 1621 is 4, below 1750 is 5, otherwise 6. A three-position switch at 988 / 1500 / 2012 µs lands in positions 1, 4, and 6.

tasks.title: The value from the knob on Plane (AP_Tuning)
tasks.statement: Plane: `TUNE_CHAN_MIN = 1000`, `TUNE_CHAN_MAX = 2000`, `TUNE_RANGE = {r}`. The parameter value at the moment of selection (the center) is **{c}**. The knob has passed the middle and is at **{p} µs**. What is the parameter?
tasks.solution: The knob position is k = (PWM − 1500) / 500, from −1 to +1. Above the middle: center · (1 + k · (RANGE − 1)); below it: center / RANGE + (k + 1) · (center − center / RANGE). The module's example: center 0.3, RANGE 2 → 1000 µs: 0.15; 1250: 0.225; 1750: 0.45; 2000: 0.6.
